text:
carmen: CI alert — trivy flagged an unexpected ELF at /usr/local/bin/fastsync inside docker.redwood.com/runtime:sha256:abcd1234. Not in SBOM. Pinging @sre-oncall for triage.
sec-bot: Automated detection: image-scan -> HIGH (unknown-binary). Incident queued INC-2026-045.
ben: can you paste the raw trivy output, SBOM path, and cosign verify result?
carmen: trivy output pasted below:
```
2026-03-20T15:22:03Z TRIVY: found file /usr/local/bin/fastsync (ELF)
Severity: HIGH
Description: binary not referenced in SBOM layers.json
```
carmen: cosign verify output:
```
$ cosign verify docker.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:abcd1234
error: no cosign signatures found
```
ash: Quarantining image in registry now: created tag registry.redwood/quarantine/runtime:sha256-abcd1234 and set deny-deploy policy on release pipeline for that digest. @eng-sre notified. :lock: 
kyler: Recommend immediate rotation of KMS signing key used by the builder pipeline and revoke the builder service account's signing role until we validate. Also add an audit marker for this action.
dave: I'll add a temporary RBAC block on the release pipeline and a fallback to the previous stable image. Opening infra PR now.
ben: I'll run reproduce steps locally: `docker pull docker.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:abcd1234 && trivy image docker.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:abcd1234` and re-generate SBOM.
carmen: reproduced locally, same artifact present. ELF binary reports compilation timestamp 2025-11-12 and embedded string 'build-tools@external'. Looks like third-party tool slipped into builder image.
sec-bot: Detection rule correlated similar artifacts built by same CI runner. Suspect set: sha256:abcd1234, sha256:efgh5678, sha256:ijkl9012.
ash: Post-incident immediate actions (short): 1) quarantine all affected images 2) rotate builder KMS key 3) revoke builder IAM perms 4) re-run SBOM generation and sign artifacts 5) export audit logs to secure S3 and notify compliance 6) prepare postmortem template.
kyler: I'll own KMS rotation and IAM revoke (ETA ~2h). @ben you own SBOM regen and signature verification (ETA ~1h). @carmen lead investigation and initial comms for legal/customer-facing teams.
dave: Agree. Setting incident severity to P2 for now while we confirm exposure. Escalate to P1 if any external signs of compromise.
ben: opened PR to CI adding `cosign verify` gate and sbom verification step: https://git.redwood/infraceil/ci/-/merge_requests/432. Running pipeline now.
carmen: drafting internal comms and timeline. Will attach minimal repro + artifact list to the incident ticket. Also adding metadata tag to quarantined images: `x-redwood-quarantine:true`.
sre-oncall: please ensure audit logs include who rotated keys and which tokens were revoked — we need an immutable record for compliance.
ash: added audit export job to incident runbook.
ben: CI passed cosign verify as failing (expected) — SBOM regen in progress.
kyler: after key rotation we'll re-sign only verified SBOM-anchored images. No re-use of old key.
carmen: thanks team. I'll summarize next status in 30 minutes. :hourglass:
